name: karpathy-wiki
description: VS Code extension for managing a local wiki with Copilot Chat integration

chatParticipants.name: wiki
chatParticipants.description: Answer questions from your wiki with grounded references

commands.name: query
commands.description: Answer a wiki question using grounded page evidence

commands.name: search
commands.description: Search and answer questions using grounded wiki references

commands.name: rebuild
commands.description: Rebuild wiki index from current wiki pages

commands.name: ingest
commands.description: Ingest raw documents into the wiki

commands.name: model
commands.description: Propose an OpenMetadata-style model enhancement from grounded wiki evidence

wiki.rawDir.description: Path to raw documents folder (relative to workspace root)

wiki.wikiDir.description: Path to wiki folder (relative to workspace root)

wiki.cacheDir.description: Path to cache folder (relative to workspace root)

wiki.maxFileSize.description: Maximum file size to process in bytes (100MB default)

wiki.debounceMs.description: File watcher debounce delay in milliseconds

wiki.rebuildOnStartup.description: Automatically rebuild index on extension startup

wiki.enableRemoteAnswerSynthesis.description: Explicitly allow remote chat-model synthesis for the Direct Answer section; grounded local evidence selection remains active and the extension will disclose when remote synthesis is used

wiki.groundTruthMode.description: Controls how @wiki answers questions: strict keeps answers grounded in wiki evidence only, while flexible stays wiki-first but may supplement with broader model knowledge when allowed.

wiki.enableRemoteLLM.description: Allow the extension to call remote LLM services for guideline transformations when explicitly enabled. Defaults to false to comply with local-first policy.

wiki.pdfBackend.description: PDF extraction backend (pdfjs for client-side, python-backend for server) — T042

wiki.maxConceptsPerPage.description: Maximum number of concepts/topics to extract per page (1-50) — T042

wiki.backlinkMinConfidence.description: Minimum fuzzy-match confidence threshold for backlink insertion (0.0-1.0) — T042

wiki.showIngestProgress.description: Show progress bar and status messages during ingestion (T041)

wiki.enableConceptExtraction.description: Enable automatic concept extraction during ingest

wiki.enableBacklinkInsertion.description: Enable automatic backlink insertion during ingest

wiki.autoRebuildIndexAfterIngest.description: Automatically update index.md and glossary.md after ingestion
